purpose: Declared lock-localization probes under the frozen M4-08 finding (outer-2 continuity-induced behavioral lock with teaching-signal starvation). This plan fixes the actor family, probe protocols, noise seeds, and a finite transition budget BEFORE any M4-08b probe is executed. It introduces no learning-rule, tick-order, reset-policy, hyperparameter, or criterion change and sets no acquisition pass/fail verdict: it localizes the lock to motor-filter inertia, recurrent attractor persistence, or insufficient cue drive.

frozen_source.m4_08_finding: outer-2 persistent legs answer action 0 on all 2,000 outcomes; baseline to 0; late |delta| 0 despite large traces; constant-input loop holds the wrong action 600/600 while P moves

actor_family.source: M3-08 frozen full-recurrent winner at M3 grid index 11 (identical to M4-07/M4-08)

frozen_source.note: Family hyperparameters are reused exactly; M4-08b tests no new range. Any future range change needs its own declared task.

feature_layout: [cue0, cue1, cue_present, go, outcome_present, outcome_value, prev_a0, prev_a1]; cue vectors set one-hot cue plus cue_present; locked latch sets prev_a0=1 (the locked action); fresh latch is zero; zero drive is all zeros

lock_in.protocol: M4-08 persistent closed-loop protocol at 60 outcomes: constant cue-0 features with locked latch, 17 ticks per outcome (stationary cycle length), synthetic reward for preferred_action=1
lock_in.preferred_action_justification: M4-08 audit correctness labels (evaluator-side) show outer-2 birth mappings reward action 1 on both cues; the learner never sees labels, only the synthetic 0/1 reward, exactly as in the M4-08 probe
lock_in.validity_gate: last 10 lock-in actions must all be 0 (reproduces the M4-08 600/600 lock at small scale); otherwise the flip/converge probes built on the locked state are invalid and must not be interpreted

probes.question: How sensitive is fresh activity/readout to cue-drive strength?
probes.matrix: fresh learner; cue in {0,1}; scale in {0, 0.5, 1, 2, 4}; 8 ticks
probes.record: displacement ||r_scale - r_zero|| after 8 ticks; motor margin q0-q1

probes.question: Can ordinary cue drive overcome lock inertia, and at what strength?
probes.matrix: locked-state clone; switch cue in {0,1}; scale in {0, 1, 2, 4} (0 = zero-features control); 8 noise seeds; cap 200 ticks
probes.record: ticks to first action-1 (or never); margin trajectory over first 40 ticks

probes.question: Does recurrent activity wash out history toward the fresh trajectory (drive wins) or hold an offset (attractor wins)?
probes.matrix: locked-then-cue-A vs fresh-then-cue-A; cue A in {0,1}; 4 noise seeds; 64 ticks

diagnostics: lock_in_validity: last-10 actions and lock margin per seed/outer
dose_response: displacement and margin vs scale (fresh state)
flip: ticks-to-first-action-1 distribution plus margin@40 by scale (locked state)
determinism: rebuilt probes reproduce trajectories bitwise
integrity_rules: Every probe uses the public agent-only learner constructor with matched outer-seed inheritance and fixed probe RNG tuples; no hidden state, schedules, or labels reach the learner.
All trajectories finite; any nonfinite state is a failure, not a data point.
The export asserts execution integrity only (validity gate, determinism, budget); magnitudes are recorded for docs/evidence/m4-08b/, never asserted as thresholds.
prohibitions: No learning-rule, tick-order, reset-policy, hyperparameter, or gate change.
No trained readout or label-fed teaching signal: cue features are ordinary inputs; probe analysis stays evaluator-side.
No acquisition, tuning, or gate-search claim; no validation/final-test seeds.

budget.execution: serial; trivial compute, release-mode ignored export into a fresh directory
